feeds.title: Historical Novel Society
feeds.description: Historical Novel Society site is a curated collection of original long-form articles — including author interviews, book launches, historical-fiction essays, and themed guides — drawn from its print magazines and commissioned for the website.

feeds.title: This Day In Alternate History
feeds.description: The blog covers insights on events that occurred on a particular day in the past years that shaped the whole human history.

feeds.title: What If?
feeds.description: Musings of an historical fantasy novelist based on the Isle of Skye, Alternate History and much more.

feeds.title: Kristine Kathryn Rusch » Alternate History
feeds.description: The author blogs on topics such as historical fiction, horror, fantasy, alternate history and much more. It also contains Current news. New York Times and USA Today bestselling author Kristine Kathryn Rusch writes in almost every genre.

feeds.title: Prometheus Blog » Alternate History
feeds.description: Read news articles, interviews on Best young adult fiction, Alternate History on the Prometheus Blog. This blog is published by the Libertarian Futurist Society.

feeds.title: The Counterfactual History Review
feeds.description: The Counterfactual History Review surveys the world of historical speculation, collecting and commenting upon examples of counterfactual reasoning. It features occasional reviews of alternate history novels and films, as well as links to news stories that reflect the growing impact of speculative historical thinking on popular culture.

feeds.title: Daniel Ottalini » Alternate History
feeds.description: Info on books and novels related to alternate history in this particular section. Daniel Ottalini is the author of The Steam Empire Series, a fantastical Roman-Steampunk Alternate History story brought to life in his debut novel, Brass Legionnaire.

feeds.title: David's Book Blurg » Alternative History
feeds.description: Latest musings and insights on the alternative history. David's Book Blurg is a book review website from author David a UK resident who gives honest and helpful book reviews.

feeds.title: The Book Binder's Daughter
feeds.description: The Book Binder's Daughter, curated by Melissa, offers eclectic book reviews spanning literary fiction, classics, poetry, and history. With a penchant for small presses and expertise in Latin and Ancient Greek, Melissa's blog delves into diverse literary realms, including literature in translation and travel writing.

feeds.title: Shannon Selin Blog
feeds.description: The author writes about historical fiction/alternate history and also about Napoleonic and 19th century history. She lives in Stratford, Canada, where she is working on the next novel in her Napoleon series.

feeds.title: TOR.COM » Alternate History
feeds.description: This section covers all the fiction and excerpts in Alternative history. Tor.com is an online magazine and community site that covers science fiction, fantasy, and all the many related subjects that interest us as readers.
